import unittest
from pool.connection import ConnectionPool

class TestPool(unittest.TestCase):
    def test_pool(self):
        p = ConnectionPool(lambda: object(), max_size=2)
        c1 = p.acquire()
        c2 = p.acquire()
        p.release(c1)
        c3 = p.acquire()
        self.assertEqual(c1, c3)

if __name__ == '__main__': unittest.main()
